## 0d9784b230ca

**Finding A2 — the selected generator’s stated rule contradicts the canonical executed rule.** Source SHA-256: `8903fff4dddf6b6e419737fb69f69aba3c9b728b2ef7f1d708df03435b4f9e99`; executed canonical rule hash: `354eb7f28777`.

The module `SUMMARY` says the three marker cells 5/6/7 stay unchanged and only the missing fourth corner receives a fill color. On canonical train pair 0, the input passes the generator’s `self_check`. The exact documented behavior therefore yields the original 5/6/7 markers plus an 8 at the missing corner. The protected canonical Racket program instead recolors **all four** cells of the local 2×2 block to 8, matching the canonical label and disagreeing with the module’s described transformation. This is not an ambiguous prose detail: it changes three output cells and can mislead any metadata-driven authoring or reviewer.

Separately tighten the public axis/texture contract and pin the authority hash; do not change the canonical rule merely to match the stale prose.
